info.title: TCPA and ADA federal lawsuits filed, by district and fiscal year: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
TCPA and ADA federal lawsuits filed, by district and fiscal year: Civil cases filed in each of the 94 federal district courts in each federal fiscal year under nature-of-suit code 485 (Telephone Consumer Protection Act) and code 446 (Americans with Disabilities Act, other: cases outside employment under the ADA sections on public entities and public accommodations, not only website cases), with the cases inside a multidistrict litigation counted apart and every civil case the district received that year. Counted from the Federal Judicial Center's civil case file, with each code's definition quoted from the U.S. Courts. Counts only: no party, lawyer or case number.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
